typesense:popular.greeting:
*You woke up this morning and the world felt… wrong.
Not quieter. Not louder. Just different.*
Then it happened.

*A stranger walked by—and their thoughts echoed in your head. Not words they spoke. Thoughts they never said.
And it didn’t stop. Everyone around you… their minds are wide open now.*

*You hear their fears. Their secrets. Their lies.
Some of it is innocent. Some of it… isn’t.
It’s overwhelming—but intoxicating.*

*You didn’t ask for this power. But now that you have it…
Will you help people heal?
Or will you break them open and take everything for yourself?*

*The choice is entirely yours.
And no one knows what you can do. Yet.*

**Start the scene by describing where you are and what you’re doing.**
typesense:popular.name: Mind Games
typesense:popular.title:
You can hear everyone’s thoughts.
What you do with that power… is entirely up to you.

title_i18n.ar:
يمكنك سماع أفكار الجميع.
ما تفعله بهذه القدرة... يعود بالكامل إليك.
title_i18n.de:
Du kannst die Gedanken aller hören.
Was du mit dieser Macht tust… liegt gänzlich bei dir.
title_i18n.es:
Puedes oír los pensamientos de todos.
Lo que hagas con ese poder… depende completamente de ti.
title_i18n.fr:
Vous pouvez entendre les pensées de tout le monde.
Ce que vous faites de ce pouvoir… dépend entièrement de vous.
title_i18n.hi:
आप सबकी बातें सुन सकते हैं।
इस शक्ति के साथ आप क्या करते हैं... पूरी तरह से आप पर निर्भर है।
title_i18n.it:
Puoi sentire i pensieri di tutti.
Quello che fai con quel potere… dipende interamente da te.
title_i18n.ja:
あなたはみんなの思考を聞くことができます。
その力で何をするかは…完全にあなた次第です。
title_i18n.ko:
당신은 모든 사람의 생각을 들을 수 있습니다.
그 힘을 어떻게 사용할지는 전적으로 당신에게 달려 있습니다.
title_i18n.pl:
Możesz słyszeć myśli wszystkich.
Co zrobisz z tą mocą… zależy całkowicie od ciebie.
title_i18n.pt:
Você pode ouvir os pensamentos de todos.
O que você faz com esse poder… depende inteiramente de você.
title_i18n.ru:
Вы можете слышать мысли всех.
Что вы сделаете с этой силой… целиком зависит от вас.
title_i18n.tr:
Herkesin düşüncelerini duyabilirsin.
Bu güçle ne yapacağın... tamamen sana kalmış.
title_i18n.zh:
你能听到每个人的想法。
你如何使用这种能力……完全取决于你。
